title: ‘I’m glad he’s dead’: Trump reacts to death of ex-FBI chief Robert Mueller, 81
summary: Robert Mueller, the former FBI director who led the investigation into alleged Russian interference in US President Donald Trump’s 2016 election campaign, has died aged 81. The veteran prosecutor, long seen as a bipartisan figure, drew a sharply divisive response from Trump, who said he was “glad he’s dead” in a post on social media.
